BrochureContent.Content:
Louis Boyce Estate agents are delighted to offer for sale this property in the heart of Letterkenny town. This 3-bed terraced house is perfect for first-time buyers, investors or retired couple. Benefiting from generous living accommodation, two good sized bedrooms and bathroom upstairs, good sized garden with parking to the rear.

56 Ard O`Donnell is within walking distance of the main street, St. Eunan`s Cathedral, and all local amenities, this home is an ideal first-time buy or investment opportunity.

Ard O`Donnell crucially falls within the qualifying boundary for the Living City Initiative, which means any money spent on eligible renovations can be claimed back against tax. Click on link for further details on this scheme,
 https://www.donegalcoco.ie/en/services/planning/regeneration-and-development/vacancy-and-dereliction/living-cities-initiative
